findings.quote: The microreactor was capped with a teflon pressure cap and placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC.
findings.message: Step 8 treats the preheated block as a separate HeatChill operation without a vessel. The source describes placing the microreactor into an already heated block, followed by the heated stirring represented in step 9. Preserve the apparatus-placement detail as an unmapped action rather than an additional reaction-heating step.
The plan omits the GC/MS completion check preceding solvent removal. Preserve it as an unmapped action because the allowed operations do not represent analytical monitoring.

value.evidence: placed into pre-heated aluminum block at 80 oC
value.reason: Placement of the microreactor into an already preheated block is not separately represented by an allowed operation; the subsequent heated stirring is represented by HeatChill.
GC/MS was used to judge completion before THF removal; analytical completion checks are not represented by an allowed operation.
